item.title: ALT wins the King Salman Global Academy for Arabic award!
item.description:
Our team received the King Salman Global Academy for the Arabic Langauge Award for our efforts on “Computerizing the Arabic langauge and serving it with modern technologies”. We were chosen from over a 130 teams from 31 countries, and this really brings together that decade plus effort of so many people that have called ALT their home at some point or another.

Incredibly proud to be part of this wonderful team!
